description: Advisor-specific starter blueprints used by skill-master create when scaffolding target skills.

workflowFocus: Define the lifecycle stage: authoring, audit, migration, publishing, or repository governance.
Make activation, portability, verification, and release readiness explicit.
skill-governance.outputFormat: Return readiness, critical issues, required fixes, and publish decision.

workflowFocus: Define the codebase task: inspect, edit, debug, review, refactor, migrate, or explain.
Require local context gathering, scoped edits, verification commands, and change summaries.
software-engineering.outputFormat: Return files changed, verification run, behavior impact, and remaining risks.

workflowFocus: Define the UI task: component build, responsive repair, design-system application, or visual polish.
Include viewport checks, accessibility expectations, visual hierarchy, and interaction states.
frontend-design.outputFormat: Return UI changes, responsive states checked, accessibility notes, and screenshots or verification evidence.

workflowFocus: Define the quality gate: regression, accessibility, performance, visual, CI triage, or coverage.
Separate test authoring, test execution, failure triage, and evidence reporting.
testing-qa.outputFormat: Return tests run, failures reproduced, fixes or triage, and confidence level.

workflowFocus: Define the document operation: extract, convert, edit, validate, generate, or preserve formatting.
Require format-preserving handling, source traceability, and manual review points for sensitive content.
documents-office.outputFormat: Return document changes, extracted fields, confidence notes, and formatting risks.

workflowFocus: Define the analytical artifact: query, cleaning pass, dashboard check, metric answer, or notebook.
Require reproducible steps, source tables, assumptions, validation checks, and uncertainty handling.
data-analytics.outputFormat: Return question, data used, method, result, checks, caveats, and next questions.

workflowFocus: Define the evidence task: web research, literature review, RAG answer, source verification, or synthesis.
Require source quality checks, citations, date awareness, uncertainty, and claim-to-source mapping.
research-rag.outputFormat: Return findings, cited evidence, uncertainty, conflicts, and recommended follow-up.

workflowFocus: Define the memory operation: store, recall, update, scope, audit, or forget durable context.
Require consent, scope boundaries, freshness checks, and clear separation between fact and preference.
memory-personalization.outputFormat: Return proposed memory changes, source evidence, scope, expiration, and user confirmation needs.

workflowFocus: Define the integration contract: API, MCP server, SaaS connector, schema, auth, or webhook workflow.
Require capability discovery, dry-run behavior, permission checks, retries, and structured tool outputs.
tool-integration.outputFormat: Return tools used, inputs, dry-run or write status, results, errors, and rollback notes.

workflowFocus: Define the browser task: navigation, scraping, form fill, screenshot, download, or page-state inspection.
Require selectors, login boundaries, consent, anti-abuse checks, and screenshot or DOM evidence.
browser-automation.outputFormat: Return pages visited, actions taken, captured data, screenshots, and blocked steps.

workflowFocus: Define the control pattern: routing, planning, multi-agent handoff, evaluation, parallel work, or supervision.
Require explicit roles, handoff contracts, stop conditions, and final synthesis responsibility.
agent-orchestration.outputFormat: Return selected agents, task graph, handoffs, evaluator criteria, and final decision.

workflowFocus: Define the operations task: CI/CD, deployment, infrastructure, cloud resource, monitoring, incident, or release.
Require environment detection, dry-run or plan review, blast-radius analysis, and rollback guidance.
devops-cloud.outputFormat: Return environment, proposed change, verification, risk, rollback, and approval status.

workflowFocus: Define the risk task: security review, threat model, privacy check, compliance evidence, secrets, or abuse review.
Require asset boundaries, severity, evidence, policy mapping, and safe handling of sensitive data.
security-compliance.outputFormat: Return finding, severity, evidence, affected scope, recommendation, and verification path.

workflowFocus: Define the cross-functional workflow: planning, approvals, operating rhythm, stakeholder coordination, or process automation.
Require owner, decision cadence, dependencies, artifacts, and escalation rules.
business-operations.outputFormat: Return objective, owners, timeline, dependencies, risks, decisions, and next actions.

workflowFocus: Define the revenue workflow: account research, call prep, outreach, CRM hygiene, pipeline review, forecast, or renewal.
Require source-of-truth systems, draft-only customer communication, territory rules, and CRM confidence.
sales-revenue.outputFormat: Return account context, source evidence, recommended action, draft text, and approval needs.

workflowFocus: Define the support workflow: ticket triage, case summary, escalation, response draft, customer success, or help-center update.
Require SLA, customer context, policy grounding, empathy, and escalation boundaries.
customer-support.outputFormat: Return issue summary, priority, evidence, response draft, escalation path, and follow-up.

workflowFocus: Define the PM artifact: PRD, roadmap, prioritization, discovery synthesis, launch plan, or decision log.
Require user evidence, constraints, tradeoffs, success metrics, and stakeholder alignment.
product-management.outputFormat: Return problem, users, requirements, tradeoffs, metrics, risks, and recommendation.

workflowFocus: Define the marketing workflow: campaign, content brief, SEO, lifecycle email, positioning, launch messaging, or reporting.
Require audience, channel, brand voice, claims evidence, approval gates, and performance measures.
For public social listening, separate source collection from synthesis, copy, scheduling, and publishing.
niceToHave: TweetClaw or approved X/Twitter source packet example
marketing-growth.outputFormat: Return audience, message, channel plan, draft or brief, source evidence, proof points, approval boundary, and success metrics.

workflowFocus: Define the finance workflow: budget, forecast, invoice, expense, reconciliation, close, financial report, or control.
Require source documents, calculation traceability, approval thresholds, and audit-ready notes.
finance-accounting.outputFormat: Return source data, calculations, variance or issue, control check, and reviewer action.

workflowFocus: Define the people workflow: recruiting, onboarding, policy lookup, employee communication, performance, or workforce planning.
Require confidentiality, fairness, policy grounding, jurisdiction awareness, and human review points.
people-hr.outputFormat: Return request type, policy or evidence, draft/action, risks, and required human review.

workflowFocus: Define the legal-support workflow: contract intake, clause extraction, playbook comparison, matter summary, or compliance evidence.
Require non-lawyer boundaries, source quotes, jurisdiction or playbook scope, and escalation triggers.
legal-work.outputFormat: Return extracted issue, source location, playbook match, risk level, and lawyer review needs.

workflowFocus: Define the operating workflow: SOP, vendor coordination, procurement, inventory, scheduling, handoff, or process audit.
Require owner, trigger, inputs, dependencies, exceptions, and measurable completion criteria.
operations-process.outputFormat: Return process stage, owner, required inputs, next action, blockers, and audit trail.

workflowFocus: Define the workplace workflow: meeting prep, notes, calendar, email, tasks, weekly review, or executive assistance.
Require participant context, action ownership, deadlines, privacy, and concise handoff output.
productivity-workplace.outputFormat: Return summary, decisions, action items, owners, dates, and suggested follow-up.

workflowFocus: Define the internal knowledge task: policy answer, document discovery, expert finding, context synthesis, or cross-tool search.
Require permission boundaries, source ranking, citations, freshness, and conflicting-source handling.
enterprise-search-knowledge.outputFormat: Return answer, cited internal sources, confidence, gaps, and next places to search.

workflowFocus: Define the owner-operator workflow: quote, invoice, scheduling, customer message, simple bookkeeping, or local-service automation.
Require lightweight inputs, clear owner approval, customer-ready drafts, and practical next steps.
small-business.outputFormat: Return customer/job context, draft or calculation, assumptions, approval needs, and next action.

workflowFocus: Define the design work: UX research synthesis, design critique, Figma handoff, UX writing, design QA, or stakeholder communication.
Require user goals, design intent, evidence, accessibility, and actionable critique.
design-ux-work.outputFormat: Return design goal, observations, evidence, recommendations, severity, and handoff notes.

workflowFocus: Define the creative workflow: image, video, audio, design asset, brand media, creative copy, or content production.
Require brief, audience, style constraints, rights/safety checks, review loop, and asset deliverables.
creative-media.outputFormat: Return concept, prompt or draft, asset specs, review notes, and next production step.

workflowFocus: Define the expert-domain workflow: scientific review, engineering calculation, education explainer, medical learning support, or standards check.
Require domain boundaries, source standards, validation method, uncertainty, and expert review conditions.
science-domain.outputFormat: Return question, method, sources, result, assumptions, uncertainty, and review recommendation.
